Survival concerns the operating business, not an unchanged corporate structure, ownership, or individual product.

criteria.support_condition: First establish material difficulty raising the targeted capital on the post date. Then establish a financially driven permanent shutdown, liquidation, or terminal distressed disposal that ends OpenAI as an operating business.
criteria.contradiction_condition: The antecedent must first be established. Survival or additional financing through a finite date does not conclusively contradict an indefinite failure forecast; no finite survival deadline was supplied.
